top_signals.title: EU Is Taking Harder Line on China’s Trade Gap as Talks Kick Off
top_signals.summary: The European Union is striking a more assertive approach to China as it heads into two days of negotiations in Beijing aimed at avoiding an economically damaging trade war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Gains with Other Metals as China Returns in Positive Mood
top_signals.summary: Copper rose alongside other metals as Chinese traders returned in a buying mood from a week-long holiday that had temporarily muted activity in Asian markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Singapore Banks’ Hot Rally Stutters Over Surging Bond Yields
top_signals.summary: Singapore bank shares extended declines for a second day after JPMorgan Chase & Co. warned that surging long bond yields will hurt third-quarter earnings for Southeast Asian lenders.
